patterns.note: The hero section features a full-width background image with an overlaid text block anchored to the bottom left, providing a clear focal point upon page load.
Product and service offerings are presented in multi-column grids (3 or 4 columns), each item typically includes an image, title, and a brief description or price.
A dedicated section uses an asymmetrical layout, pairing a large, impactful image on the left with a text block for 'AB:Collection' on the right, breaking the grid pattern.
Headings like 'O noua imagine' and 'AB:Collection' use a large, modern sans-serif typeface, while body text and navigation employ a smaller, highly legible sans-serif for clarity.
Brand logo 'ADINA BUZATU' in the header and footer is rendered in a prominent, uppercase, bold sans-serif, conveying strength and modernity.
The primary color palette is monochromatic, dominated by black, white, and various shades of gray, allowing product imagery to provide the main bursts of color.
Text on dark image overlays or backgrounds is consistently white for high contrast and readability, while text on light backgrounds is dark gray or black.
A persistent cookie consent bar is positioned above the main content, providing options to 'Acceptă tot' or 'Configurează' via distinct button styles.
The footer is structured into multiple columns, presenting various categories of links (e.g., 'La dispozitia ta', 'Companie', 'Legal și cookies'), contact information, and social media links.

technique_notes: To achieve the hero text overlay, place text content within a container positioned absolutely over a full-width background image. Use padding and a semi-transparent dark gradient or solid background on the text container for readability.

Implement image grids using CSS Grid or Flexbox, ensuring images within each grid item maintain a consistent aspect ratio. Text information is typically placed directly below the image or overlaid at the bottom with a dark gradient.

Create the prominent 'AB:Collection' section by using a two-column layout where one column holds a large image and the other contains the heading and descriptive text. Align the text block vertically to start mid-way or lower on the image side for visual interest.
